hooks.command: bash -lc 'p="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}"; [ -z "$p" ] && p="${CODEX_PLUGIN_ROOT:-}"; if [ -z "$p" ]; then for d in "$HOME"/.codex/plugins/cache/*/building-flutter-apps/*; do [ -x "$d/hooks/scripts/dart_gate.sh" ] && p="$d" && break; done; fi; exec "${p:?building-flutter-apps plugin root not found}/hooks/scripts/dart_gate.sh"'
